summary: v0.3.1 is shipped and stable. The Mission Control mod is built and published in the repo as a plugin; it just needs merging to main to be installable. Next app work: scrape the 3 new dungeons and the 2026-10 meta follow-ups.

needsYou.text: Say 'make the PR' so the Mission Control plugin can merge to main
needsYou.why: Plugin installs read your main branch, so /plugin install only works after the merge.

needsYou.why: Only a real Player.log tells us whether Exalt names your location.

needsYou.text: Confirm the transparent overlay + dungeon quick-pick behave on your setup
needsYou.why: Focus/click-through can't be checked from a Linux container.

needsYou.why: So I build what you'll actually use.
